Ostend Type

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. A type foundry publishing text faces for long-form reading, with an emphasis on scripts that are usually an afterthought.

Our families ship with full Cyrillic and Greek coverage from the first release rather than as a later extension, because retrofitting a script produces a face that reads like a translation.
